statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the group is not empty, the estimate MUST be at least the actual number of articles available and MUST be no greater than one more than the difference between the reported low and high water marks.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MUST accept all three cases; servers MUST NOT represent an empty group in any other way.

statements.description: Clients MUST accept all three cases; servers MUST NOT represent an empty group in any other way.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Servers SHOULD use this method to show an empty group.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Articles may be reinstated in the group with the same article number, but those articles MUST have numbers no less than the reported low water mark (note that this is a reinstatement of the previous article, not a new article reusing the number).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Except when the group is empty and all three numbers are zero, whenever a subsequent GROUP command for the same newsgroup is issued, either by the same client or a different client, the reported low water mark in the response MUST be no less than that in any previous response for that newsgroup in this session, and it SHOULD be no less than that in any previous response for that newsgroup ever sent to any client.
actions: include low water mark in response that is no less than the low water mark in any previous response for that newsgroup in this session

actions: include low water mark in response that is no less than the low water mark in any previous response for that newsgroup ever sent to any client

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Any failure to meet the latter condition SHOULD be transient only.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a valid group is selected by means of this command, the currently selected newsgroup MUST be set to that group, and the current article number MUST be set to the first article in the group (this applies even if the group is already the currently selected newsgroup).
actions: set currently selected newsgroup to the specified valid group
set current article number to the first article in the group

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If an invalid group is specified, the currently selected newsgroup and current article number MUST NOT be changed.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The GROUP or LISTGROUP command (see Section 6.1.2) MUST be used by a client, and a successful response received, before any other command is used that depends on the value of the currently selected newsgroup or current article number.
actions: receive successful response before issuing any command that depends on currently selected newsgroup or current article number

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the group specified is not available on the server, a 411 response MUST be returned.
